description: Runs a Content Autopilot task once, now, without changing its schedule. Use when the user wants to test an automation or get its next item right away. Not for turning the schedule on (use set_autopilot_task_state). Returns the outcome and the new item's ID on success. Each run uses content minutes, with up to 20 successful runs per user per day. Adds the item to the team library, visible to members in the app, and assigns it to the task's clients; nothing is posted to social.

task_id.description: ID of the autopilot task. Get it from list_autopilot_tasks.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: run_autopilot_task_now
title: Run content automation now
